title.en: Publish localized Disclaimer and public Subscription footer access
title.zh: 发布本地化免责声明与公开订阅页脚入口

purpose.en: Give every supported interface language a reviewed Disclaimer and a public footer path to subscription or plan information while requiring sign-in only when a user starts payment.
purpose.zh: 为每种受支持的界面语言提供经审阅的免责声明，并从公共页脚开放订阅或套餐信息；仅在用户开始付款时要求登录。

en: Expose six localized footer links in the required About, Privacy, Terms, Disclaimer, Subscription, Project order.
Keep the subscription, pricing, membership, plan, or course catalog readable without sign-in and preserve sign-in enforcement on payment actions.
Publish the generic localized Disclaimer covering AI-assisted inaccuracies, pricing errors, third-party platforms, crypto risk, and final non-refundable payments.
zh: 按关于、隐私、条款、免责声明、订阅、项目的规定顺序公开六个本地化页脚链接。
订阅、定价、会员、套餐或课程目录无需登录即可阅读，并保留付款动作的登录要求。
发布通用本地化免责声明，涵盖 AI 辅助内容不准确、定价错误、第三方平台、加密资产风险以及最终且不可退款的付款。

en: Public footer, Disclaimer route, public subscription catalog, deployment verification, and Project release history
zh: 公共页脚、免责声明路由、公开订阅目录、部署验证与 Project 发布历史

en: Add localized Subscription labels for all 21 shared locales and route each site to its existing public catalog.
Cover X, Facebook, TikTok, wallet applications, and crypto exchanges in the localized Disclaimer.
State that all payments are final and non-refundable except where applicable law requires otherwise.
zh: 为共享的 21 种语言新增本地化订阅标签，并将每个站点链接到其现有公开目录。
在本地化免责声明中覆盖 X、Facebook、TikTok、钱包应用及加密货币交易所。
明确除适用法律另有强制要求外，所有付款均为最终付款且不可退款。

en: Run shared footer, Disclaimer, public-catalog, and payment-boundary contract tests plus the production build.
Deploy through GitHub Actions and Cloudflare, verify production Disclaimer and Subscription access, and confirm the exact Project record.
zh: 执行共享页脚、免责声明、公开目录与付款边界契约测试及生产构建。
通过 GitHub Actions 与 Cloudflare 发布，验证生产免责声明和订阅访问，并确认精确的 Project 记录。

en: Acoustic speech-scoring acceptance remains a separate opt-in human test and is not part of the default repeat-off 3 AM run.
zh: 声学语音评分验收属于另行选择开启的真人测试，不属于默认关闭跟读的凌晨 3 点任务。

en: Preserve the existing 03:00 America/Los_Angeles LaunchAgent schedule, anonymized learner, Clerk/Gmail secret-handling boundary, Cloudflare deployment, and SmartLingo-only scope.
No other site, account, credential, payment rail, or cloud resource is modified.
zh: 保持现有 America/Los_Angeles 凌晨 3 点 LaunchAgent 计划、匿名测试学习者、Clerk/Gmail 敏感信息边界、Cloudflare 发布及仅限 SmartLingo 的范围。
不修改其他站点、账户、凭据、支付通道或云资源。
